readings.title: The Fruit of Lawful Obedience
readings.subtitle: Eating the labour of your hands within the divine hedge.
readings.text: [Psalm 128:1] Blessed are all who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Who walk in <dn>His</dn> ways. [2] You shall eat the labour of your hands. Be blessed, and let it be well with you. [3] Let your wife be As a fruit-bearing vine within your house, Your sons like olive plants all around your table. [4] Look, so shall the man be blessed Who fears <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Blessed Increase of Tsiyon
readings.subtitle: Witnessing the generational peace upon Yisra’ĕl.
readings.text: [Psalm 128:5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall bless you out of Tsiyon, And let you see the good of Yerushalayim All the days of your life, [6] And let you see your children’s children! Peace be upon Yisra’ĕl!

readings.subsection: The Enduring Affliction of the Chosen
readings.title: The Ploughers on the Back
readings.subtitle: The righteous Creator cuts the cords of the wrong.
readings.text: [Psalm 129:1] <dq>“Often they have distressed me from my youth.”</dq> Let Yisra’ĕl now say, [2] <dq>“Often they have distressed me from my youth, But they have not overcome me. [3] “The ploughers ploughed on my back, They made their furrows long.”</dq> [4] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is righteous, <dn>He</dn> has cut the cords of the wrong in two.

readings.subsection: The Barren Future of the Adversary
readings.title: The Terminal State of Tsiyon's Enemies
readings.subtitle: Withered grass that yields no harvest or blessing.
readings.text: [Psalm 129:5] Let all those who hate Tsiyon Be put to shame and turned back. [6] Let them be as the grass on the house-tops, Which withers before it grows up, [7] That shall not fill the reaper’s hand, Nor the sheaves fill the binder’s bosom. [8] And those who pass by shall not say, “The blessing of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be upon you; We have blessed <dn>את</dn> you in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!”

readings.title: A Cry Out of the Depths
readings.subtitle: If You watched crookedness, who could stand?
readings.text: [Psalm 130:1] Out of the depths <dn>I</dn> have cried to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [2] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, hear <dn>my</dn> voice! Let <dn>Your</dn> ears be attentive To the voice of <dn>my</dn> prayers. [3] O <dn>Yah</dn>, if <dn>You</dn> should watch crookednesses, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who would stand? [4] But with <dn>You</dn> there is forgiveness, That <dn>You</dn> might be feared.

readings.title: Waiting for the Morning Watch
readings.subtitle: With YeHoVaH there is loving-commitment and absolute redemption.
readings.text: [Psalm 130:5] <dn>I</dn> looked to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>My</dn> being has looked, And for <dn>His</dn> word <dn>I</dn> have waited. [6] <dn>My</dn> being looks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> More than those watching for morning, watching for morning. [7] O Yisra’ĕl, wait for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; For with <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> there is loving-commitment. And with <dn>Him</dn> is much redemption, [8] For <dn>He</dn> shall redeem <dn>את</dn> Yisra’ĕl From all his crookednesses.

readings.title: A Place for the Mighty One
readings.subtitle: The vow to establish a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Ya’aqoḇ.
readings.text: [Psalm 132:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, remember Daviḏ, <dn>את</dn> All his afflictions; [2] How he swore to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Vowed to the Mighty One of Ya’aqoḇ: [3] <dq>“Not to enter into my dwelling-house, Not to get into my bed, [4] “Not to give sleep to my eyes, Or slumber to my eyelids, [5] “Until I find a place for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Ya’aqoḇ.”</dq>

readings.title: Arise to Your Place of Rest
readings.subtitle: Seeking the ark of His strength in the fields of the forest.
readings.text: [Psalm 132:6] See, we heard of it in Ephrathah; We found it in the fields of the forest. [7] Let us go into <dn>His</dn> dwelling places; Let us bow ourselves at <dn>His</dn> footstool. [8] Arise, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to <dn>Your</dn> place of rest, <dn>You</dn> and the ark of <dn>Your</dn> strength. [9] Let <dn>Your</dn> priests put on righteousness, And <dn>Your</dn> lovingly-committed ones shout for joy. [10] For the sake of <dn>Your</dn> servant Daviḏ, Do not turn away the face of <dn>Your</dn> Anointed One.

readings.title: The Oath of Eternal Inheritance
readings.subtitle: The eternal promise sworn in truth to the fruit of Daviḏ's body.
readings.text: [Psalm 132:11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sworn in truth to Daviḏ; <dn>He</dn> does not turn from it, <dq>“Of the fruit of your body <dn>I</dn> set upon your throne. [12] “If your sons guard <dn>My</dn> covenant And <dn>My</dn> witnesses that <dn>I</dn> teach them, Their sons shall sit upon your throne forever.”</dq>

readings.subsection: The Divine Center of the Cosmos
readings.title: The Eternal Choice of Tsiyon
readings.subtitle: Setting up a lamp and shining a diadem upon the Anointed One.
readings.text: [Psalm 132:13] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen Tsiyon, <dn>He</dn> has desired it for <dn>His</dn> dwelling: [14] <dq>“This is <dn>My</dn> place of rest forever; Here <dn>I</dn> dwell, for <dn>I</dn> have desired it. [15] “<dn>I</dn> greatly bless her provision, <dn>I</dn> satisfy her poor with bread. [16] “And <dn>I</dn> put deliverance on her priests, And her lovingly-committed ones sing for joy. [17] “There <dn>I</dn> make the horn of Daviḏ grow; <dn>I</dn> shall set up a lamp for <dn>My</dn> Anointed One. [18] “<dn>I</dn> put shame on his enemies, While on <dn>Him</dn> <dn>His</dn> diadem shall shine.”</dq>

readings.title: The Night Watch in the Set-Apart Place
readings.subtitle: Lift your hands and bless the Maker of the heavens and earth.
readings.text: [Psalm 134:1] Come, bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, All you servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Who are standing in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by night! [2] Lift up your hands in the set-apart place, And bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Maker of the heavens and earth, Does bless you from Tsiyon!

readings.title: Praise for the Chosen Possession
readings.subtitle: Praise the Name, for YeHoVaH has chosen Ya’aqoḇ.
readings.text: [Psalm 135:1] Praise <dn>Yah</dn>! Praise <dn>את</dn> the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Praise, you servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [2] Who are standing in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, In the courts of the House of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, [3] Praise <dn>Yah</dn>, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is good; Sing praises to <dn>His</dn> Name, for it is pleasant. [4] For <dn>Yah</dn> has chosen Ya’aqoḇ for <dn>Himself</dn>, Yisra’ĕl for <dn>His</dn> treasured possession.

readings.title: The Master of Cosmos and Nations
readings.subtitle: He does whatever pleases Him, striking down the reigns of Kena’an.
readings.text: [Psalm 135:5] For <dn>I</dn> know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is great, And our Master is above all mighty ones. [6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has done whatever pleased <dn>Him</dn>, In the heavens and in earth, In the seas and in all the depths, [7] Causing vapours to go up From the ends of the earth; <dn>He</dn> made lightning for the rain, Bringing forth wind from <dn>His</dn> treasuries; [8] Who struck the first-born of Mitsrayim, From man to beast. [9] <dn>He</dn> sent signs and wonders Into your midst, O Mitsrayim, On Pharaoh and on all his servants; [10] Who struck many nations, And killed mighty sovereigns, [11] Even Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites, And Oḡ sovereign of Bashan, And all the reigns of Kena’an. [12] And <dn>He</dn> gave their land as an inheritance, An inheritance to Yisra’ĕl <dn>His</dn> people.

readings.title: The Impotence of Human Engineering
readings.subtitle: The idols of the nations have no breath; their makers become like them.
readings.text: [Psalm 135:13] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> Name is forever, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> remembrance to all generations, [14] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rightly rules <dn>His</dn> people, And has compassion on <dn>His</dn> servants. [15] The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands. [16] They have mouths, but they do not speak; They have eyes, but they do not see; [17] They have ears, but they do not hear; Also there is no breath in their mouth. [18] Those making them become like them, Everyone who is trusting in them.

readings.title: The Unified Blessing from Tsiyon
readings.subtitle: Bless YeHoVaH, O house of Yisra’ĕl, you who fear His Name!
readings.text: [Psalm 135:19] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O house of Yisra’ĕl! Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O house of Aharon! [20] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O house of Lĕvi! You who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! [21] Blessed from Tsiyon, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be, Who dwells in Yerushalayim! Praise <dn>Yah</dn>.
